translations.web: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to Yahweh your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”
translations.bsb: Now please forgive my sin once more and appeal to the LORD your God, that He may remove this death from me.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death
translations.asv: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and entreat Jehovah your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
